name: Iced Latte
steps: Chill four tall glasses and measure the dilution liquid. Prepare clean drinking-water ice.
Brew four single espresso shots, about 30 ml each, using 9 g ground coffee per shot. Leave them to stop steaming for a minute.
Divide the ice evenly between the four glasses.
Pour chilled milk over ice, then add the espresso slowly.
Serve immediately. Stir gently if you prefer a uniform flavour; do not shake drinks containing sparkling water.
tips: Serve freshly prepared. Adjust sweetness after tasting.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
